correctness.rationale: The associative group-ring transport is direct. The augmentation ideal is nilpotent for the elementary abelian p-group, excluding nonzero augmentation-zero fixed points. The convolution augmentation-one group is abelian of exponent p; its H-equivariant ideal-power quotients split over F_p by Maschke. The augmentation ideal is a regular F_q[H]-module, making the exact kernel size q^d. Exhaustive original-product checks cover eight small cases, but the proof, not the tests, establishes all q.
